MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Sydney Fairbairn, Esq. appeared American Express Company.
No appearance by defendant Firouzeh Foroutan.
Default was entered against defendant on September 29, 2010.
Doe defendants were dismissed September 29, 2010.
Order waiving witness appearance at default prove-up hearing was filed on February 1, 2010.
Dismissal without prejudice as to defendant Salem Kangarloo was filed today March 30, 2010.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff American Express Company, and against the Defaulted Defendant Firouzeh Foroutan as follows:

Damages/Principal - $33,034.40.
Prejudgment Interest - $10,733.30.
Attorney's Fees - $8,200.00.
Costs - $575.00, for a total judgment in the amount of $52,542.70.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
